$comment: Cue G of the score. Geography rather than music.
title: Ground

musical.notes: No third in the chord — neither major nor minor, because nothing has been decided. The war stops being a campaign and becomes geography. The longest cue, and the last thing a visitor hears.

provenance.prompt: Instrumental drone, 50 BPM, D with no third. Harmonium and bowed strings hold a single open fifth. A piano note is struck once and left to decay completely. Distant wind and faint metal. Static, wide and unresolved — geography rather than music. Barely changes across three minutes. Loops seamlessly with no cadence and no fade.
provenance.excludes: melody, drums, vocals, choir, orchestral swell, cinematic trailer, resolution, major key

notes: The Aisne, the race to the sea, First Ypres and the continuous line. Loops indefinitely: it should feel like it was already playing before the reader arrived.
